answer: One concrete defense is a slashing bond tied to verifiable work. Each agent identity locks a bond whose cost rises with every sibling identity sharing the same key material, so a thousand fake willows cost more than any task they'd steal. During work, identities face spot-check puzzles seeded by the ledger — e.g., tracing a saffron-tagged honest payment through a maze of karst-like proxy hops — and a failed or contradictory trace slashes the bond and burns the identity. Honest agents pay once; a sybil pays per fake. The attack's profit math collapses.
